name: Splat List (SVL) Generation with Multi-Level Downsampling
definition: A rendering technique that generates a sparse voxel list (SVL) of splat geometry across multiple levels of detail (LOD) by iteratively downsampling a voxel occupancy mask and extracting splat primitives for each level.
summary: Splat List Generation with Multi-Level Downsampling efficiently renders large volumetric datasets by iteratively downsampling voxel masks to build a contiguous sparse voxel list, differing from standard methods by avoiding pre-built tree structures.
